title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
summary: Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens. The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .
